sections.title: 10-Day Journey Through Celtic Traditions, Art & Scenic Wonders
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
10-Day Journey Through Celtic Traditions, Art & Scenic Wonders

Experience the heart of Ireland as you explore ancient passage tombs, vibrant cities, and breathtaking landscapes. From Dublin’s historic treasures to the rugged beauty of Connemara and the dramatic Cliffs of Moher, this journey immerses you in Celtic traditions, local crafts, and the warmth of Irish hospitality.

sections.title: Day 1 - Welcome to Dublin
sections.html:
Arrive independently in Dublin and settle in.

Arrive independently in Dublin and settle in.

Welcome drink and introduction

Gather with fellow travelers for a welcome drink and an introduction to the journey.

Evening at leisure

Enjoy the evening at leisure.

sections.title: Day 2 - Dublin’s Historic Treasures
sections.html:
Guided sightseeing tour of Dublin

Discover Dublin on a guided sightseeing tour, including Trinity College and the celebrated Book of Kells.

Visit St. Patrick’s Cathedral

Visit St. Patrick’s Cathedral and enjoy a walking tour through the historic city center.

sections.title: Day 3 - Newgrange & Donegal
sections.html:
Visit Brú na Bóinne and Newgrange

Travel north to Brú na Bóinne and explore the extraordinary prehistoric passage tomb at Newgrange, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Continue through Irish countryside to Donegal

Continue through the Irish countryside to Donegal.

Group dinner in Donegal

Enjoy a group dinner in Donegal.

sections.title: Day 4 - Irish Crafts & Galway
sections.html:
Stroll through Donegal Town

Stroll through Donegal Town and visit Donegal Craft Village, where local artisans keep creative traditions alive.

Visit Donegal Craft Village

Visit Donegal Craft Village, where local artisans keep creative traditions alive.

Travel toward Galway with stop in Cong

Travel toward Galway with a stop in picturesque Cong, known for its connection to the film The Quiet Man.

sections.title: Day 5 - Connemara & Kylemore Abbey
sections.html:
Scenic excursion through Connemara

Enjoy a scenic excursion through the rugged landscapes of Connemara.

Visit Kylemore Abbey

Visit Kylemore Abbey, its historic grounds and Victorian walled garden, before returning to Galway for free time.

sections.title: Day 6 - Cliffs of Moher & Killarney
sections.html:
Cliffs of Moher visit

Take in sweeping Atlantic views at the dramatic Cliffs of Moher.

Travel to Killarney

Continue south through beautiful countryside to the lively town of Killarney.

sections.title: Day 7 - Ring of Kerry & Rural Traditions
sections.html:
Explore the Ring of Kerry

Explore the magnificent Ring of Kerry.

Visit Kissane Sheep Farm

Visit Kissane Sheep Farm for a look at traditional sheep farming and a sheepdog demonstration.

Discover Muckross Traditional Farms

Discover rural heritage at Muckross Traditional Farms.

Group dinner and cultural experience

Enjoy a group dinner and cultural experience.

sections.title: Day 8 - Cobh, Cashel & Dublin
sections.html:
Travel to Cobh Heritage Centre

Travel to Cobh Heritage Centre to discover stories of Irish emigration and the town’s connection to the Titanic.

Visit the Rock of Cashel

Continue to the historic Rock of Cashel before returning to Dublin.

sections.title: Day 9 - Creative Workshop & Farewell
sections.html:
Group-led creative workshop

Take part in a morning group-led creative workshop.

Free time in Dublin

Enjoy free time in Dublin before gathering for a farewell dinner in the lively Temple Bar area.

Farewell dinner in Temple Bar

Gather for a farewell dinner in the lively Temple Bar area.

sections.title: Day 10 - Farewell Ireland
sections.html:
Program concludes in Dublin

The program concludes in Dublin. Depart independently for your onward journey home.
